title: Agency Specialist - Associate
full_description:
London, United Kingdom
OverviewA facility agent acts as the primary point of contact between the transaction parties to a syndicated loan. Appointed in the credit agreement, the agent acts as a neutral intermediary between the borrower and the lenders and performs the administrative tasks of the loan. This includes handling cash flow and providing on-going transaction support during the lifecycle of deal. In the event that discretionary action is required, the role of the agent is non-fiduciary which means the agent must follow the action of the majority lenders.
In their role as facility and /or security agent, the London agency team are part of the wider EMEA agency platform and support a wide range of deals originating from various industry sectors including but not exclusive to; Corporates, Financial Institutions (predominantly Insurance and Investment Funds), Shipping, Infrastructure, Real Estate and Acquisition Finance. In coordination with the Offshore teams the agency function is responsible for delivering a control conscious and client focused service.
Main duties and responsibilities of the role:Working autonomously, you will become part of a team dedicated to maximising their potential and providing outstanding client service. In a market where speed and flexibility are key, continuous improvement and being responsive to the needs of our clients is a must.
